verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents official SDKs, but only as mobile-app libraries that come with instructions, examples and project files. The core integration surface is a REST API, with no evidence of official server-side or language SDKs. The published OpenAPI spec is only a developer building block for generating clients, so it earns no SDK credit. missing for 10: official server-side/backend language SDKs for the REST API, SDK reference depth (languages, versions, maintenance), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: SDKs provide mobile application developers with self-contained libraries for implementing Signifyd. Each SDK include instructions, examples, and project files to allow you to quickly add Signifyd to an existing project.
